Drainage

Having the proper drainage system around your property in Lake Mary, FL, will alleviate expensive repairs down the road!

Free estimatesResidential & commercialLake Mary & Central FL
Get a free quote Call 407-717-8191

What this is

Drainage installation in Lake Mary and the surrounding areas.

Blue Fox Landscape & Services can professionally install a variety of drainage systems that'll ensure rain and irrigation runoff is directed away from your property. Our drainage specialists will come out and evaluate your current drainage system to determine what steps need to be taken to divert water away from your property, then review the findings with you, offering you a free no-obligation quote.

In Central Florida, drainage is usually the reason the last landscape failed. Water with nowhere to go takes the turf first, then the beds, then the base under the pavers — and in an afternoon storm it can reach the house.

Blue Fox project · Paver patio, lawn and new planting in a back yard

What affects the scope

  • Where water collects after rain
  • Downspouts and roof runoff
  • Irrigation runoff
  • Grade between the house and the lot line
  • Pool decks and patios that pond
  • Turf, beds and pavers affected

Questions

Before you call.

How do I know if I have a drainage problem?

Water that stands for hours after rain, turf that dies in the same low spot every summer, soil washing out of beds, or water pooling against the house or on a pool deck. If you have noticed any of those, mention it on the estimate call.

Is the drainage evaluation free?

Yes. Our drainage specialists evaluate the property and review the findings with you, with a free, no-obligation quote.

Can drainage be done with new sod or landscaping?

Yes — and it is better to solve it before the new landscape goes in than after.
